tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.special_circumstance: switchover to new penal charges regime on next review/renewal date or six months from the effective date (whichever is earlier) for existing loans
tuples.quote: In the case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be ensured on next review or renewal date or six months from the effective date of this circular, whichever is earlier.
